| 0002 | Dice results: the face the simulated die rests on, with a randomized launch and fairness measured on the host | amended |
| 0005 | IMU at ±16 g, ±2000 °/s and 100 Hz on both boards; a shake is detected by how long the motion lasts, not how large it is | amended |
| 0007 | 60 fps with the panel push overlapped with drawing by DMA, and D20s with a 24 px edge | accepted |
| 0009 | Dice physics in 1/240 s steps with warm-started speculative contacts; results lock after 0.15 s below 5 mm/s and 0.5 rad/s, cocked dice get a random nudge, and fairness is tested on 18,000 D20 and 3,400 D6 results at α = 0.001 | amended |
| 0010 | The device's own motion moves the dice; each detected shake throws every die and spins it over 0.1 s to a uniformly random orientation, and the fairness test chains replayed shakes and checks repeats as well as chi-square | accepted |
| 0014 | While a roll is in flight, the level follows the reading averaged over 0.1 s, not the hold before the shake | accepted |
| 0016 | The band has its own 20 px strip above the tray, and the tray is the 115 px beneath it | accepted |
| 0019 | Each board clears its I2C bus with nine clocks and a STOP before the controller starts | accepted |
| 0020 | The StickC env builds for the Plus 2's 8 MB flash at 80 MHz, with its PSRAM left off | accepted |
